niche.habitat: Photospheric magnetic flux tubes and sunspot umbrae, where partial shielding mitigates the lethal 63 MW/m² radiative flux and steep density gradients (F21, F6).
niche.diet: Photon momentum and resonant chromospheric line absorption; converts stellar radiation into baryonic mass via ion-acoustic coupling (F22, F11).
niche.active: Rotation-synchronized (25.4 d cycle) with flare-reactive bursts during magnetic activity maxima (F2, F4).

body: A porous, helical microbe that drinks the star’s blocked light while diamagnetic current loops anchor it to magnetic flux boundaries. Its launch sacs hitch magnetoacoustic spicules, and transient current loops let it surf reconnection surges like a surfer catching a breaking wave.

links: Membrane self-organizes into an ion-acoustic plasma crystal
Sheath tunes to Ca II H&K and Mg II chromospheric lines for resonant momentum transfer
Photospheric radiative flux of 63 MW/m² bathes the cell
G2V 5800 K blackbody emission provides the photon pressure

skill.effect: The creature absorbs ambient energy from its surroundings, converting it into internal charge that strongly enhances its movement and steadily restores its vitality. It grows more agile and resilient when navigating dense energy fields.

chains.weakness: Spectral blindness: Cannot harvest in continuum-rich zones or if shielded by dense plasma clouds; charge decay causes slow drift.
observe: Membrane shifts hue to match bright spectral lines
Cell expands slightly with each intake pulse
Tracks granulation edges where flux is brightest

journal.en: They drink the line-blanketing and grow fat on the glow.

plausibility.summary: Limit the Yukawa lattice to microparticle-scale ordering inside flux-tube dusty condensations (F13, F21), not a stable membrane at τ=1; rescale Photon Siphon to radiation-pressure thrust plus slow resonant heating (~0.01–1% effective line-capture, Earth-photosynthesis order of magnitude), not 5% of 63 MW/m² s⁻¹ converted to mass/charge.

chains.weakness: Demagnetization: Reconnection events or field reversals shatter the shield, dropping the organism to the lethal granulation floor (thermal hazard zone); vulnerable during field flicker telegraphs.

journal.en: A ghost in the wires, slipping through the field like water off glass.
